ValidationRule.description: Users with the ila Marketing Platform profile cannot edit Prize Type or Category after record creation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Category__c) || ISCHANGED(Prize_Type__c), NOT(ISNEW()), $Profile.Name = 'ila Marketing - Platform' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Users with the ila Marketing Platform profile cannot edit Prize Type or Category after record creation.
